text:
Maria H: Hey finance — Velora Labs (acct VL-9842) says their March invoice INV-2026-0329 didn't include the 20% promo credit from the partnership promo. They were billed $12,480 instead of $9,984. Can we investigate and do a manual adjustment? Link to invoice: https://billing.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-0329 :eyes:

Daniel (Billing): Thanks — can you drop the account id and the promo code that should have applied? Also any screenshot from their portal would help.

Maria H: Account: VL-9842. Promo code: PARTNER20. Customer pasted the usage table and the promo banner shows active in their console. Quick copy of the invoice totals:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0329
Billed: $12,480.00
Expected after PARTNER20: $9,984.00
Difference: $2,496.00
```

Daniel (Billing): I'm checking the promo-engine logs and rules. Quick find — the PARTNER20 rule has an end_date set to 2026-03-15 in the rule metadata, but the partnership email said promo valid through 2026-03-31. Looks like the rule expiry was misconfigured.

Arthur (Finance Manager): Ok to approve a one-time manual adjustment for goodwill. Approve up to $3,000 to cover the difference and any minor rounding. Please document why and tag the partnership owner.

Daniel (Billing): Got approval from Arthur. I'll create a manual credit ADJ-89214 for $2,496 and apply it to INV-2026-0329. I'll also open a ticket to correct the promo rule and add a regression test. ETA: by EOD.

BillingBot: Adjustment created: ADJ-89214 | Amount: $2,496.00 | Invoice: INV-2026-0329 | Status: pending approval.

Maria H: Thanks — customer is asking for confirmation when the credit will show in their portal. Can we confirm posting time?

Daniel (Billing): Processing now. Adjustment finalized and posted as account credit. Journal entry JE-45788 created. Refund not issued (applied as account credit) per Velora preference. Should appear in their portal within 15 minutes.

BillingBot: Ledger note: JE-45788 — Customer credit applied (ADJ-89214). Status: posted. Notifications sent to account owners and support. :thumbsup:

Elena (Support): I can follow up and confirm with Velora once they see it. Ping me if you want a follow-up message drafted.

Daniel (Billing): Please do, thanks. I'll add a note in the invoice thread and link the promo rule ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-7214 (fix promo expiry).
